results: 1. Measure pupil diameter in light and dark

pupil examination (size, light reaction): mild anisocoria; the RIGHT pupil is unreactive to dim light, with involuntary pupillary spasms that are irregular in both frequency and duration and unrelated to eye position
2. Perform slit-lamp examination of the anterior segment
ocular motility examination: exotropia, hypotropia and motility impairment - a right oculomotor nerve palsy

pupil examination (size, light reaction): mild anisocoria; the RIGHT pupil is unreactive to dim light, with involuntary pupillary spasms that are irregular in both frequency and duration and unrelated to eye position
visual acuity and colour vision: normal
pain and periorbital inspection: no pain, no swelling, no discolouration
3. Order MRI of the brain with contrast
MRI brain with contrast: no lesion, no cranial nerve enhancement
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Idiopathic isolated oculomotor nerve palsy with aberrant regeneration (pupil-sparing)
1. Microvascular ischemic third nerve palsy (e.g., undiagnosed hypertension or hyperlipidemia)
2. Compressive lesion of the oculomotor nerve not visualized on MRI (e.g., small aneurysm or cavernous sinus pathology)
3. Miller Fisher syndrome
